g.title: staged->advance
g.text: dispatch condition, or scalar stack empty

g.title: output->finish
g.text: after all pending work is processed

g.title: runner
g.text: CPU fallback handler and output sink.

g.title: loop
g.text: Start output; assign nodes; drain all pending work.

g.title: select
g.text: Native particle handle + history and step IDs

g.title: route
g.text: Check return markers, particle and environment support.

g.title: scalar
g.text: Native C8 tracking and process sequence

g.title: staged
g.text: HybridCascade then erases the native stack entry.

g.title: advance
g.text: CPU expansion, or bounded photon/lepton batches

g.title: backend
g.text: Resident queues, physics views and Kokkos kernels

g.title: results
g.text: Stage unfinished EM work; return CPU work;

g.title: output
g.text: Replay returned records into C8 writers.
